criterion_scores.reasoning: The numbered decisions are implemented consistently: both adapters refuse --bundle combined with --context/--spec-file, the bundle build emits a parity warning, and quote verification now normalizes before matching while preserving an exact-match count. I checked the main touched code paths and did not find a contradiction to the supplied spec.

The patch covers the requested behavior and adds tests for the bundle-refusal cases and quote-normalization edge cases. Minor nit: the new evidence_parity warning path in judge_lib.py is not directly regression-tested, so that load-bearing build-time behavior could regress without an explicit test failure.

File placement and house-doc updates are in the expected locations, and the skill/spec docs now point to the rebuild-vs-rerun guidance. I did not see violations of the project-vs-alex naming convention or the parent-thread/tooling constraints in the touched files.

The patch removes the prior overbroad quote matching and avoids the specific anti-pattern called out in the spec (blanket stripping and fake quote verification). It also avoids duplicating state; the new exact-match count is explicitly secondary rather than replacing the tolerant match.

The refusal and parity messages are explicit, actionable, and sent to stderr where applicable. The quote-verification docstring also explains the contract and the residual behavior. Minor nit: the new parity-warning behavior would benefit from a direct test to make failure modes even more legible.

defects.description: The new build-time evidence-parity warning is implemented, but this patch does not add a direct regression test that exercises the false-parity bundle path and asserts the unmissable stderr warning. That leaves a load-bearing path unpinned even though the behavior is now required by spec.
